name: Berry
long_description:
Berry is the AI Renewal Agent for B2B SaaS. We help you retain and grow long-tail revenue while cutting labor costs.

Your long-tail customers are too costly for dedicated rep coverage, but their collective revenue is too valuable to ignore.

Berry fully manages your long tail, freeing your reps to grow top accounts. It drives value realization, closes renewals, and unlocks cross-sells and upsells. From proactive outreach to commercial negotiation, it engages your customers across channels and languages, 24/7.

Built for revenue and CS leaders who want higher NRR at a lower cost to serve.
one_liner: AI Renewal Agent for Your Long Tail.
